device_model.reason: Safari does not reliably expose the hardware model

methodology.fps: render submission cadence after the game FPS cap, not proof of displayed frames
methodology.average_fps: 1000 * frame count / sum of active rendered frame intervals
methodology.percentiles: estimates from fixed histograms: 0.125 ms bins below 64 ms, 0.5 ms below 256 ms, 2 ms below 512 ms, powers of two above
methodology.low_1_percent: 1000 / estimated mean of the slowest ceil(1% of frames), using bucket means at the boundary
methodology.cpu: measured JS main-thread wall time for update, events, HUD and render submission; not utilisation or GPU time
methodology.gpu: measured asynchronous existing WebGL2 timer queries every 12 rendered frames; disjoint results rejected
methodology.memory: JS heap and owned texture bytes are estimates when exposed; process memory, VRAM, battery and temperature unavailable
methodology.raw: uniform reservoir of rendered frame observations; independent benchmark RNG, no simulation RNG changes
methodology.conditions: overlapping steady-play labels; shots: 1 second, explosions: 2 seconds, indoors/population sampled once per second
methodology.spike: frame interval > max(50 ms, twice the configured frame budget)
methodology.stutter: frame interval > 1.5 times the configured frame budget
methodology.warmup: first 15 active seconds of each match; background/menu/loading excluded; resume primes the frame clock
methodology.histogram: sparse rows [bucket index, frame count, sum_ms]; see benchmark-stats.js for bin bounds

degradation.note: Uncontrolled maps, settings, combat and DRS can explain change; this does not establish thermal throttling
